Maharashtra doctors end strike after court intervention over homeopathy practice

Resident doctors in Maharashtra began an indefinite hunger strike on March 11, protesting a government decision to allow homeopathy practitioners to register and practice modern medicine. The doctors demanded clarity and regulation on the issue. The Bombay High Court intervened, issuing a stern warning and ordering the doctors to call off their strike, stating "What if patients die? Can you bring them back to life?". Following the court's order, the resident doctors withdrew their strike.
